hypotheses.title: Batch 74: Tri-Candidate Orthogonal Breakout (Playbook High-Conviction Yield Engines)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Applies the Tri-Candidate Batch Protocol (Batch Size Invariant: exactly 3 candidates) combining the Playbook's orthogonal economic hypotheses with valuation yield scaling (/ close) and non-linear decile concentration to eliminate community correlation and achieve Spectacular/Excellent ratings: (1) Sloan Accrual Yield & Free Cash Flow Reinvestment Rate (H01/H03) isolating unmanipulated cash generation in TOP1000. (2) Consensus Net Income Yield & 60-Day EPS Revision Velocity (H11) capturing institutional analyst upgrades in TOP2000. (3) LEAP Call Term Structure & 30-Day Put/Call Skew Exhaustion (H15) harvesting variance risk premia in TOPSP500.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if fundamental yields or options variance premia deteriorate under subindustry/sector neutralization during monetary policy inflections.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Sloan Accrual Yield & FCF Reinvestment Super Alpha): High cash flow relative to accounting operating income scaled by price isolates unadulterated cash earnings per share, paired with 1-year free cash flow return on assets.

Candidate 2 (Analyst Consensus Yield & 60-Day Revision Super Alpha): Combines consensus forward net income yield with 60-day analyst EPS revision velocity scaled by price to exploit institutional consensus drift in TOP2000.
Candidate 3 (LEAP Call Term Premium & 30-Day Skew Exhaustion Super Alpha): Couples long-term 3-year institutional call positioning with short-term put/call skew mean reversion in TOPSP500.
